animation_sampling_boundary: runtime_root uses GetBoneTransform with bUseRawData=false, which requests compressed sampling but may fall back to raw data. raw_root explicitly requests raw sampling; compressed-data validity is recorded per clip.
texture_dimension_boundary: Editor imported FTextureSource dimensions are authoritative here; render dimensions are recorded separately and may be zero under NullRHI. This does not prove cooked texture residency.
root_basis_boundary: A fixed uniform positive reference-root scale is recorded, while every sampled root must preserve the reference transform and sampled bone scales must preserve reference scales. Physical height, feet and forward direction still need measured scene validation.
boundary: Actual imported skeletal assets and sampled animation transforms. This does not verify feet contact, deformation quality, silhouette attractiveness, retarget compatibility, or visual release alignment.
animation_duration_policy: Idle2s, Move1s, Hit0.4s, Defeat1s, Victory1.5s; Attack uses current source export preset max(0.6s, authored windup+0.4s); Active max(0.5s, authored cast+recovery).
